name: @oscharko-dev/keiko-ui
description: Keiko Wave 1 local UI (static export). Build-time-only; served by the Node BFF in keiko-server.

scripts.typecheck:native: npm --prefix ../.. run check:typescript-toolchain && node ../../node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false

_browserslistRationale: Corrected from chrome/edge>=79, firefox>=72, safari>=13.1, which the shipped UI code has not
satisfied for a long time: 33 production call sites use Array.prototype.at(-n) (Firefox 90,
Safari 15.4), 20 use crypto.randomUUID (Firefox 95, Safari 15.4), and lib/api.ts uses
AbortSignal.timeout (Firefox 100, Safari 16) — every one of them beyond the old floor, so the
declaration promised engines on which the app cannot start. These floors correspond to the
Baseline 'widely available' set and cover every API the UI actually calls. Enterprise Windows
fleets run evergreen Edge/Chrome, so this is not a reachability change for them; it makes the
declaration true. check:browser-baseline enforces it against the source.
